notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents which are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, either creating a token copy of Smothering Tithe or causing Court of Vantress to become a copy of Smothering Tithe.
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe and the Smothering Tithe copy trigger for each opponent you have, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
